name: tr_moody
caption:
IF MOSES MOODY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🧊 Frigibax: the more heat it soaks up, the more power it stores. We took him #14 out of Arkansas in 2021
🦗 Lokix: when it fights all out, it enters Showdown Mode. 37 points for Santa Cruz in the G League
🐉 Baxcalibur: Frigibax all grown up, its breath freezes lava. A career-high 30 against Denver as a rookie
🐭 Maushold: against strong foes, the whole family joins the fight. A ring with us in his rookie year, 2022
🐟 Veluza: excellent regeneration. Surgery on a torn ligament in his right thumb, then right back
🔥 Armarouge: it wears a distinguished warrior's armor and is incredibly loyal. Last season: a career-high 12.1 a night, 49 starts

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Moses Moody had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF MOSES MOODY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Frigibax. The more heat it soaks up, the more power it stores. We took him fourteenth out of Arkansas.
beats.dlg: IT SOAKS UP HEAT.|PICK 14 OUT OF ARKANSAS!

beats.vo: Lokix. When it fights all out, it enters Showdown Mode. Down in Santa Cruz, he dropped thirty-seven in an overtime win.
beats.dlg: IT ENTERS SHOWDOWN MODE.|37 IN THE G LEAGUE!

beats.vo: Baxcalibur. Frigibax grew up, and its breath can freeze lava. As a rookie, a career-high thirty against Denver.
beats.dlg: ITS BREATH FREEZES LAVA.|ROOKIE: 30 VS DENVER!

beats.vo: Maushold. When the foe is strong, the whole family joins the fight. A ring with us in his rookie year.
beats.dlg: THE WHOLE FAMILY FIGHTS.|A RING AS A ROOKIE!

beats.vo: Veluza. It has excellent powers of regeneration. A torn ligament in his right thumb, then surgery.
And the ace. Armarouge. It wears the armor of a distinguished warrior, and it's incredibly loyal. Last season, career highs: twelve point one a night, forty-nine starts.
beats.dlg: A WARRIOR'S ARMOR, LOYAL.|CAREER-HIGH 12.1 A NIGHT!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Moody: played college basketball for Arkansas; drafted 14th overall by Golden State in 2021; January 11, 2022 with the Santa Cruz Warriors (G League): 37 points in a 132-130 overtime win; March 7 (2022, rookie): career-high 30 points vs Denver; won the 2022 NBA Finals in his rookie season; May 22 (2025): surgery on a torn ulnar collateral ligament in his right thumb; 2025-26: 60 games, 49 starts, career-high 12.1 points
Frigibax: the higher the temperature, the more energy it stores
Lokix: when it decides to fight all out, it enters Showdown Mode
Baxcalibur (evolves from Frigibax): its cryogenic air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava
Maushold: when facing strong opponents, the whole group (family) will join the fight
Armarouge evolved through armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior; it is incredibly loyal
